correctness.rationale: A length-n closed path in the pair graph imposes exactly cyclic consistency of overlapping pairs, even at n=1,2, so Boolean diagonal reachability detects existence, not number, of predecessors. Independently reproduced the exact finite certificate by using each output bit b as the backward function (u,v)→(b XOR (u OR v),u), rather than the uploaded Boolean matrix code. Replay: python3 /workspace/independent/rule30.py. It found 41 reachable functions, 11 with no fixed point, the six initial orphan counts 1,1,3,5,6,12, and zero recurrence errors for all 41 required shifts n=1..41; direct integer-rotation enumeration agreed for n=1..14. Integer word populations evolve under the 41-by-41 transfer, so Cayley–Hamilton for the shifted scalar error sequence forces every later error to vanish. The order-six annihilator factors as (t^3-1)(t^3-t^2-2), so matching six starts proves the cubic power sum plus period-three correction and the stated generating function. The real cubic root is unique and in (1,2); the product of its conjugate pair is 2/alpha, whose square-root modulus is below alpha by the cubic equation. Both constant inputs map to zero on the ring. On the bilateral shift any finite target window can be inverted from a pair on its right by left-permutivity, and compactness yields an unrestricted predecessor. Thus finite nonsurjectivity and bilateral surjectivity are consistent.
